title: Untagged variant ordering comment is accurate but could be more defensive
description: In crate-jmap-types/src/query.rs lines 22-26, the comment correctly documents why Operator must come before Condition in the untagged enum. This is correct and the comment is good. However, there is no #[doc(hidden)] or compile-time guard preventing future developers from reordering the variants. A stronger approach would be a doc comment example showing the failure mode, or a serialization test that would break if the order changed. The existing tests (filter_operator_or_roundtrip) cover this implicitly. This is a documentation/robustness observation at P4.
